# Atoll source

Atoll is imported from https://github.com/Ebullioscopic/Atoll at commit `503606ca34aece08d30d3c86bce50eb5e07a3139`.
AtollExtensionKit is imported from https://github.com/Ebullioscopic/AtollExtensionKit at commit `296562051f4ee8fec55aaca14782b21b8e63cafa`.
Both snapshots were imported on 2026-07-24.

Atoll is GPL-3.0 licensed.
Keep `Atoll/LICENSE`, `Atoll/NOTICE`, copyright headers, and source availability with distributed builds.

The upstream Atoll Git LFS budget was exhausted during import.
The initial source snapshot therefore contains LFS pointer files for optional media assets.
Do not claim those media features are verified until the real assets are restored from upstream.
